::: {#thm-pearson-test-null}
#### Null distribution of the correlation t statistic

Let the pairs $(X_1, Y_1), \ldots, (X_n, Y_n)$ be independent,
and let each $Y_i$, given $\dsn{X}$,
be Gaussian with a mean and variance that do not depend on the $X$ values.
Then the statistic $t$ of @def-pearson-test has the $t_{n-2}$ distribution
[@hoggtanis2015, Section 9.6, pp. 472-473]:

$$
t \sim t_{n-2}.
$$
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#rem-pearson-test-conditions}
#### When the conditions hold

The conditions of @thm-pearson-test-null hold, for example,
when the pairs are independent draws
from a bivariate Gaussian distribution with $\rho = 0$.
:::
